messages:
Ava_finance: Quick FYI — we're planning a pricebook experiment rollout starting Mon 2026-04-05. This includes a small per-embedding tweak + tiered credit adjustments. Need ops checklist for invoice impacts and grandfathering (proposed 4-week window). Pinged billing + legal for approvals.

miguel_billing: Can you confirm exact cohort definition? Also need to know whether adding column `applied_rate_id` to invoices is acceptable for downstream parsers.

priya_sales: Are we excluding enterprise customers with custom contracts? We promised no surprise billing for them.

sophie_legal: Exclude any contract tagged "enterprise" or with SLA/custom pricing. I'll run a quick contract sweep and flag any contractual blockers. Also we should include a short customer-communication template for review.

tom_platform: @miguel_billing I'll prepare a staging query to generate the cohort. Example SQL to validate:
```sql
SELECT id, customer_id, plan_id, next_billing_date, rate_override_flag
FROM subscriptions
WHERE next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-04-05' AND '2026-05-03';
```
Run in staging first.

miguel_billing: OK will run tomorrow in staging and drop CSV. Also want to validate invoice preview generation — using: `./tools/invoice-preview --cohort pricebook-v1 --sample 50`

Ava_finance: Canary proposal: 5% traffic first 24h -> 25% for next 3 days -> full rollout on day 7 if metrics OK. Rollback triggers: revenue delta > 5% in 24h OR quality/regressions NPS drop > 1pt or >0.5% support ticket spike.

priya_sales: I'll coordinate AM outreach for any accounts in the live cohort. @sophie_legal can you sign off on comms copy by EOD Fri?

sophie_legal: ACK. I'll add legal-approved language and explicit "no retroactive charges" phrasing. Expect a doc by Fri noon.

billing-bot: billing-bot: invoice_preview job completed for cohort pricebook-v1 — 50 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/pricebook-v1-preview.csv

miguel_billing: CSV shared in /finance-drive. Found 6 subscriptions with manual rate overrides — these need manual mapping or a grandfather exception. Proposing we flag them as "manual-grandfather" and issue one-time credits where needed.

Ava_finance: Agree on manual exceptions for overrides. Miguel compile the override list + suggested credit offsets and add to rollout doc. We'll sign off on exceptions in the preflight call.

tom_platform: Ops note: routing rule in the payment/rate service must map `model_pricebook` -> new ratecard id `PBOOK_V1`. I'll open a PR and include deploy checklist. Also we should run the billing migration job in dry-run mode: `make billing-migrate DRY_RUN=1 COHORT=pricebook-v1`

priya_sales: :thumbsup: timeline looks good. I'll draft the customer comms and post in #marketing for review.

Ava_finance: Action items recap: Miguel run staging query (due 2026-03-28), Sophie approve comms (2026-03-27 EOD), Tom open PR for routing & dry-run (2026-03-29). If no blockers, go-live 2026-04-05 08:00 UTC with 5% canary.

priya_sales: Noted and aligned. Thanks everyone!
